scope: Frontal camera correction source study; map integration and production acceptance remain open.
crop_basis: Measured alpha>=16 and alpha>=128 bounds [64,161,1646,563], plus four source pixels of margin. Only distant alpha<16 fringe is outside this crop; steel is not clipped.
anchor_meaning: Bottom center for Tiled alignment and y-depth sorting.
sampling: NearestNeighbor; aspect ratio preserved within integer rounding; source alpha preserved without thresholding, recoloring or painting.
projection: Frontal orthographic RPG projection: horizontal rails, vertical sides, axis-aligned shallow roof band, no visible short end face.

footprint_suggestion.note: Separate approximate ground-plane blocker, narrower than the measured native silhouette. Height/roof is not collision depth; actor clearance requires map review.
